today.title: Today
today.intro: Who to call or write today. Each call ends with a tap on what happened – the next date is set for you.
today.empty: Nothing due. Well done – or add new leads.
today.unscheduled: {count} leads in research without a date
today.no_contact: No phone or email yet – research it.

leads.title: Leads
leads.quiet_hint: They replied, met you or picked up the phone once – and nothing for 90 days, no date planned. Worth a call.

org.name: Name
org.delete_confirm: Delete {name} with all people, leads and history? This can't be undone.

import.title: Import
import.intro: Upload the file made by scripts/embassy/toplist_import.py (or any JSON with an "organisations" list). Same name in the same city is merged, nothing existing is overwritten. Try a dry run first.
import.invalid: This is not an import file.
import.report: {created} new, {merged} merged, {people} people and {leads} tracks added
import.report_dry: Dry run – nothing saved: {created} new, {merged} merged, {people} people and {leads} tracks would be added

store.title: Store
store.intro: A store that sells SCUTOONS products to readers. Listed stores with at least one product are shown on scutoons.com/stores (“Where to buy”) with these fields only: name, city, country, address, website, opening info, the products – never people, emails, phones or notes.
store.listed_hint: Public: the store appears on scutoons.com/stores as soon as it carries at least one product
store.independent_hint: Small and independent shops are listed first on the public page
store.unknown_product: {id} is no longer in the shop catalog – removed when you save
store.listed_without_products: Not shown yet: listed, but it carries no product.

palette.label: Command palette
palette.keys: ↑↓ move · Enter open · Esc close · Ctrl K or / anywhere
palette.placeholder: Type a section, an organisation or a city …

mail.subject: Subject
mail.footer_note: Sent from hello@scutoons.com; the opt-out line is added.
mail.no_recipient: No address to write to – or everyone here opted out.
mail.discard_message: Nothing is sent. The draft is deleted.
mail.not_yours: Only {author} sends this draft – it goes out in their name.
mail.draft_gone: This draft was sent or discarded already.

welcome.title: Welcome to Embassy
welcome.intro: You keep in touch with the people who make the music travel: stages, record shops, bookers and press. Every week you get a small portion – the agent helps you write mails and prepare calls. Nothing is ever sent without you.
welcome.contacts: Your contacts – the ones you add yourself, and the ones an ambassador gives you (you can also take unowned ones).
welcome.portion: Your weekly portion – calls that are due first, then people who answered before and went quiet, then first contacts.
welcome.pace: Your pace – how many contacts a week feels right. Change it any time; every 4 weeks we ask if it still fits.

name.label: Your first name
name.hint: Mails and messages are signed with it (the agent uses it too). It is your account name, so readers see it in the stories as well.
name.missing: Add your first name – mails are signed with it.

pace.time: About {hours} hours a week (a mail or a short call each).
pace.label: pace
pace.checkin: {weeks} weeks at {pace} contacts a week – is your pace right?
pace.checkin_thanks: Thanks – your pace is now {pace} a week.

portion.done_week: Your portion for this week is done. Thank you!
portion.none_owned: No contacts of yours yet – add one, or take unowned ones.

hint.mail_no_answer: mail sent {days} days ago, no answer – refer to “{subject}”
hint.mail_no_answer_plain: mail sent {days} days ago, no answer
hint.no_answer: no answer {days} days ago – try again
